name: Baige Online Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Baige Online Digital Technology Co., Ltd. provides insurance intermediary services to scenario-based partners and insurance companies. Its services include insurance transaction services, precision marketing and digitalization solutions, and TPA services.
